# LoopSplit

> Official website and user documentation for LoopSplit, a shared expense app for iPhone, iPad and Android. Updated November 11, 2026. Available on the App Store and Google Play.

LoopSplit records shared expenses, recurring bills and repayments. It does not transfer money or connect to a bank. Users choose equal, shares, percentage or exact-amount splits. Receipt scanning suggests an amount, merchant and date when available; users review suggestions before saving.

Free use has no ads or daily expense limits. Each free Book supports three active Loops. Free receipt scanning is three scans total per account across devices; attaching and viewing receipt photos is free. Optional Pro subscriptions add unlimited scanning, cropping, Loops and estimated expenses. A Pro member shares Book-level Pro benefits with the other members of that Book. Local prices and trial eligibility appear in the store purchase flow.

- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.loop.loopsplit): Official Android app.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6817176363): Official iPhone and iPad app.

- [Help Center](https://loopsplit.app/support/): Version-specific instructions and support contact.
- [Free features and Pro](https://loopsplit.app/support/pro/): Limits, shared benefits, subscriptions and restore help.
